body:
Hi there,

I spent some time on carpenterbeecabinetworks.com this week. Your work looks great, but the homepage does not show it. It opens with "Welcome to our website", never lists a single service in text, and your phone number does not appear anywhere on the page, even though your contact page lists (706) 618-9238 right next to your email. A Dalton homeowner with a tired kitchen has to hunt for the SERVICES link before they learn you refinish cabinets at all. There is even a small typo in there, "sound advise" where it should be "sound advice".

So I redesigned your homepage, and it is attached to this email as a PDF. Your services sit at the top in plain text, your number is in the header, the renew instead of replace argument gets the space it deserves, and a free quote is one tap away.

Painting and home sites are a big part of my work. I built elkhornpainting.com for a painting company that needed its services presented cleanly. I also built sennesdesignbuild.com, where the remodeling work had to look as good as it turned out.

If you like it, I can put it on your real domain and build out the rest of the site. If not, keep the PDF as free ideas, no hard feelings.

Best,
Hassan
name: Carpenter Bee Cabinet Works
subject: 🐝 Your homepage never shows your phone number
